oneOf.description:
A per-attempt node timeout fired. Distinct from ordinary tool failure
so retry policy and observability can tell an unknown-outcome timeout
apart from a proven-clean error (E11).

The run-wide elapsed budget stopped this call. Distinct from node
timeout and cancellation so hosts report the actual cause (E11).

no semantics.

files.description: Suspended-step file revisions retained for resume and fork.

operation_digest.description:
Canonical digest of target + details binding this approval to the
exact operation content (A06). Approvals never transfer across
different digests even for the same node and kind. Required:
a confirmation without a digest is corrupt, never an
invocation-scoped default (Q1-5 fail-closed).

scope.description:
How far this approval reaches, recorded from the manifest
permission: `invocation` approves one call, `content` reuses the
approval for identical content until the run ends (Q1). Required:
the scope must be stated explicitly, never defaulted silently.
Wire form: `invocation` confirmations carry 4-part ids
(`node:kind:digest:invocation-hash`), `content` ones 3-part ids
(`node:kind:digest`).

ContextCompactedEventData.description:
The two payload shapes emitted by context management are deliberately kept
as separate closed objects so prompt compaction cannot silently acquire
transcript-only fields.

ContextCompactionPolicy.description: The policy used when a prompt or an agent transcript exceeded its context limit.

ElapsedAccountedEventData.description: Single durable active elapsed ledger, preserving subsecond consumption.

oneOf.description: Per-attempt timeout, distinct from execution failure and run elapsed expiry (E11).
Guard/admission refusal, not a failed execution (E11).

FilePinEventData.description: A retained workspace file revision: its path and the digest of its bytes.

FileValue.description: Canonical inline file input exchanged by the CLI, HTTP API, and engine.
FileValue.title: FileValue

answers.description: Pre-provisioned answers keyed by question id, consumed without interaction.

confirmations.description: Pre-provisioned confirmation decisions keyed by confirmation id.

priority.description: Scheduling priority, higher runs first. Defaults to 0.

package_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the complete generator package tree.

options_from.description:
Run-variable path supplying this field's options at run time, using
the same dotted paths as `ask_user.fields_from`. The value is an array
of strings or of `{ value, label?, label_i18n? }` objects. Mutually
exclusive with static `options` and valid only for runtime forms
(`ask_user`), never for pre-run `[inputs]` fields.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema applied after the canonical field-type checks.

ui.description: Renderer-specific presentation metadata forwarded to clients unchanged.

InvalidateRun.description: Caller-provided audit metadata for an irreversible successful-run invalidation.

actor_label.description:
Descriptive label, NOT authenticated identity. Nonblank, no controls;
at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

reason.description: Nonblank, no control characters; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

InvalidateRun.title: InvalidateRun

cache_retention.description:
Requested cache retention tier when non-default (`extended` only).
Absent means the provider default lifetime. Present only to make the
TTL cost basis inspectable.

cache_write_policy.description:
Requested cache write policy when non-default (`forbid` only).
Absent means the default `allow`: the request left provider caching
alone. Present only to make the TTL cost basis inspectable.

cost_microusd.description: Total estimated call cost, including any priced hosted-search charge.

retry_decisions.description: Failed provider attempts, including retries preceding a successful call.

stop_reason.description: Normalized terminal reason; absent in older journals and decision calls.

web_search.description: Hosted-search details; null when the request did not enable the tool.

available.description: False when the provider needs a credential that is not configured.

discovery.description: Whether live `/v1/models` discovery is enabled for this provider.

LlmCatalogResponse.description:
Selectable LLM provider/model catalog. Metadata only: the catalog never
carries credentials and never grants run permissions.

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last successful external catalog fetch.

stale.description: True while external metadata is missing or stale.

LlmCatalogResponse.title: LlmCatalogResponse

fallback_index.description: Zero-based index into the declared route list (0 is the primary route).

fallback_taken.description: Whether this invocation advanced to the next declared route.

routes_total.description: Number of declared routes available for this invocation.

McpCleanupPolicy.description: Settlement of a failed direct MCP session cleanup.

ParallelCompatibility.description: Compatibility preserves existing abort timing and aggregation, not replay authority.

network_deny_private_ips.description:
Opt-in SSRF hardening for the HTTP fetch path. When true, every
hop resolves ALL A/AAAA records and denies non-global IPs
(loopback, private, link-local, multicast, unspecified, reserved);
the connection is pinned to the validated addresses. Default
false so existing wildcard deployments keep working.

side_effects_scope.description:
How far one approval reaches. `invocation` (default) authorizes a
single call; `content` reuses the approval for identical content in
later calls (Q1). The serde default keeps the documented
manifest-parse-time default: an explicit `[permissions]` block may
omit the key and still resolve to `invocation`.

ProviderSearchAction.description: What one hosted search call did.

ProviderSearchEvent.description: One hosted search call reported by the provider.

id.description: The provider's identifier for the call, when it reports one.

queries.description: The queries a search action ran. Empty for page actions.

url.description: The page a page action opened. Absent for a search action.

metrics.description: Accumulated cost metrics, present when the writer attached them.

ReasoningEffort.description: Provider-neutral reasoning effort requested for a model invocation.

diagnostics.description:
Lenient specification violations recorded while inspecting the
resource (for example a skill name that differs from its directory).

oneOf.description: Snapshot copied from another run's declared artifact.

ResponseVerbosity.description: Provider-neutral control for the detail of a model response.

RetryDecision.description: One failed provider attempt, including the effective bounded decision.

attempt.description:
One-based attempt within this route (not the fallback index). Null
when gateway cancellation cannot know which router attempt is active.

guard.description: A mechanism that overrode policy, if any.

provider_code.description:
Sanitized provider `error.code` observed on this attempt, when any.
Bounded to 1..=64 ASCII `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`; absent when no
code was present, malformed, oversized, or the body was unreadable.
Capture alone changes nothing: it is inert unless a provider rule
explicitly matches it.

retry_after_applied.description:
Whether this decision will apply the observed `Retry-After` delay.
True only when a matching rule opts in and the effective action still
retries; terminal guards and route fallbacks never wait.

retry_after_secs.description:
Bounded `Retry-After` delay observed on this attempt, in seconds.
Capped at 60; absent when missing, invalid, or in the past.

RunCostMetrics.description: Per-run cost metrics with a USD estimate for display.

priced.description:
False when any billed call lacked contract pricing, so the total may
understate the true spend.

RunCostMetrics.title: RunCostMetrics

metrics.description: Accumulated cost metrics, present when the writer attached them.

reason.description:
Structured failure detail carrying the dedicated code (for example
an elapsed-deadline stop), when the writer attached one.

RunListOrder.description:
Run history sort order. Ascending is the default and preserves the
existing cursor contract; descending serves newest-first views so
recent runs never fall out of a capped fetch window (B12).
RunListOrder.title: RunListOrder

budget_charged.description:
Durable step-budget consumption (F13): sum of `budget_charged`
deltas. `steps_executed` counts `step_started` events (observational,
includes uncharged foreach children); this counter drives
`max_steps` enforcement and survives restarts identically.

tokens_cache_creation_input.description: Input tokens used to create cache entries, included in total input.

tokens_cached_input.description: Input tokens served from provider cache, included in `tokens_input`.

generator_id.description:
Owning generator id so clients never parse it from run_id (C03).
Required: a snapshot without an owner is corrupt, never something
to guess from the run id.

labels.description: Run metadata admitted with the run; never authorization.

metrics.description:
Cost totals: exact terminal metrics when finished, otherwise a live
synthesis from the folded budget. Absent only before any activity.

parent_run_id.description: Parent run id for runs created by fork.

queue_position.description: 1-based position among queued runs, present only while `Queued`.

queued_at.description:
RFC 3339 durable FIFO key while queued. Scheduler preemption may
preserve the prior key rather than stamp the latest transition time.

step_summaries.description:
Terminal outcomes folded from journal records, keyed by canonical
`NodePath` strings. Live values and outputs are not summarized here.

audit_raise.description:
Per-run audit level raise recorded at admission; it can only raise
observation persistence.

effective_max_total_steps.description: Effective step budget after resolving the deployment ceiling.

effective_policy_origin.description: Origin of the effective budget for audit display.

elapsed_budget_mode.description: Schema-1 absence means historical wall-clock accounting.

labels.description:
Free-form run metadata admitted with the run. Metadata only: the runtime
never reads identity or enforces authorization from labels.

package_sha256.description:
Full package identity for API runs. Absent on legacy/direct runs;
those runs cannot be recovered or forked by the service.

parallel_compatibility.description: Deployment-owned parallel compatibility; only fail-fast exists.

parent_run_id.description: Parent run id for runs created by fork.

priority.description: Scheduling priority recorded when the run was (re)queued.

queued_at.description:
Durable FIFO ordering key. Scheduler preemption may preserve the
prior key; fresh/fork admissions establish a new one. Absent entries
use the actual event timestamp (C04), which is never backdated.

oneOf.description:
A cancel request was accepted into the mailbox but no terminal
outcome is journaled yet. This is acceptance, not settlement: only
a journaled terminal state may report `Canceled` (A02).

operation_digest.description: Canonical digest binding the approval to the exact operation (A06).

oneOf.description:
Approval binds one invocation: a later call re-confirms even for
identical content.

Pre-provisioned answers keyed by question id, consumed without interaction.
Same semantics as eval suite answers.

audit_level.description:
Requests a higher observation-audit level for this run. The
deployment floor and the generator policy can only be raised.

confirmations.description: Pre-provisioned confirmation decisions keyed by confirmation id.

priority.description: Scheduling priority, higher runs first. Defaults to 0.

files.description: File revisions produced by this step, retained across suspension.

StepSummary.description: Journal-folded terminal summary for one canonical node path.

reason.description: Present for failed and skipped steps; success has no reason.
